judge.rationale: The answers share the principal Fxyd6–Na+/K+-ATPase mechanism and the Htr3a/Cnr1-defined CGE interneuron context, but Coro6 and Flt3 receive explanatory state or trafficking roles mainly in B–D and D adds distinct CB1–cAMP/PKA–FXYD1 coupling, leaving roughly one-quarter or more of the molecular content incompletely shared and invoking the maximum-6 ceiling.
